sections.Profile:
Williams Pharaoh pinball machine, released in 1981, features a rich Egyptian theme and offers a multi-level playfield that provides dynamic gameplay. Designed by Tony Kraemer with artwork by Seamus McLaughlin, Pharaoh includes notable features such as Magna-Save, four flippers, four kick-out holes, and a captive ball.
